The free junior AFL stats app that covers your whole season

5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games, free. Track your disposals, marks and tackles for a season of junior footy without paying anything.

Download free on the App Store

Built in Australia for community footy. iOS 18.0+.

What you actually get for $0

Not a trial. Not a teaser. This is the free plan, and it stays free. It has limits, and they are listed below.

Every AFL stat that matters

Disposals, kicks, handballs, marks, tackles, goals and behinds — plus clearances, contested ball, spoils and rebound 50s. Enter them yourself after the game, or have a parent or coach tap them in live from the sideline. Sorted into scoring, attacking, midfield and defensive categories.

5 teams, 25 players, 20 saved games

Playing in more than one age group? Part of a whole squad? Free covers up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games, which is most of a junior season. When you reach 20, delete a game or upgrade to Premium to save more.

Team mode and rotations

Track the whole side, manage player rotations, and keep an honest record of playing time — the number most junior clubs argue about and almost none can evidence.

Match Invitations

Share the stat load. Invite parents and coaches to record during the same game, so no one person misses the match trying to capture it.

Post-game Triage Dashboard

What actually happened, in the two minutes after the siren. Includes Perception vs Reality — how the game felt against what the numbers say.

Career Timeline and full history

Up to 20 games kept, with an activity timeline per match and 14 athleticism metrics tracked over time, with age and sex benchmarking. Auskick through to colts, in one place, at no cost.

Works with no reception

Full offline mode. Junior footy grounds are not known for their coverage, and nothing is lost if you have no signal.

Player Cards to share

One standard Player Card style included free — the shareable card you can send to family and friends before the oranges are finished.

What “free” means in ScorX

It's worth knowing exactly what you're downloading before round one.

1

Free, with limits you can see

Up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games. That is a total, not a monthly limit, and the numbers are on the pricing page.

2

No countdown

There is no trial clock on ScorX Free. You keep scoring, tracking and your Development Plan for as long as you use the app.

3

Yours, not your club's

It's free to you because it's free to everyone, not because a club bought a licence. Take it with you when you change clubs.

At 20 saved games, you choose.

Free keeps up to 20 saved games. When you reach 20, delete a game or upgrade to Premium to save more. No surprises mid-season.

Pricing across this category changes often. Before you commit a season to any app — ours included — check the current App Store listing and the developer's own pricing page.

Free for every coach. No exceptions.

Junior AFL runs on volunteers who are already out of pocket. Every coaching tool in ScorX — team mode, rotations, playing time, Match Invitations, the Triage Dashboard — is in the free plan and stays there, within the free limits.

There is no coach tier to upgrade to, because we didn't build one. If you're taking an under-10s side this year, you have every coaching tool.

So what does Premium add?

Being straight about this, because a free plan with a hidden catch isn't free.

Free covers recording and reviewing

Everything needed to capture your junior AFL season and look back over it — live stats, team management, rotations, game history, Career Timeline, offline mode — is free, permanently, within the free limits.

Premium covers more room and AI training

A$4.99/month or A$49.99/year removes the limits (unlimited teams, players and saved games) and adds AI training recommendations, AI Season Narratives, voice stat recording on iOS 26 and later, the full Player Card library, PDF and CSV export, and iCloud sync across devices.

30 days, no card

Try full Premium free for 30 days, no card required. Every Premium feature is on and the Free limits are lifted. If you don't subscribe at the end of it, you carry on with ScorX Free.

One subscription, shared with your family

Premium supports Apple Family Sharing for up to five members, so your parents can follow every game, and a household with more than one player doesn't pay twice.

Common questions

Is ScorX really free for junior AFL?

Yes. ScorX Free is free forever, with 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games. No credit card is required to download it or to keep using it.

How many games can I track on the free plan?

Free keeps up to 20 saved games in total, which covers most of a junior AFL season. When you reach 20, delete a game or upgrade to Premium to save more.

Do coaches have to pay?

No. Every coaching tool is free with no exceptions — team mode, rotations, playing time tracking, Match Invitations and the post-game Triage Dashboard. The free limits of 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games apply.

What AFL stats can I track for free?

Disposals, kicks, handballs, marks, tackles, goals, behinds, clearances, contested ball, spoils and rebound 50s — recorded live and grouped into scoring, attacking, midfield and defensive categories.

What's the catch?

The catch is the limits: 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games. ScorX Premium is a separate optional subscription that removes them and adds AI training recommendations, AI Season Narratives, the full Player Card library and data export. Benchmarking and your Development Plan are free.

Does the free plan work offline?

Yes — full offline mode on the free plan. Junior footy grounds aren't known for their reception, and nothing is lost if you have no signal.
